vajrolīṃ yo vijānāti sa yogī siddhibhājanam ||
tatra vastudvayaṃ vakṣye durlabhaṃ yasya kasyacit |
kṣīraṃ caikaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu nārī ca vaśavartinī ||
calitaṃ ca nijaṃ bindum ūrdhvam ākṛṣya rakṣayet ||
yāvad binduḥ sthiro dehe tāvat kālabhayaṃ kutaḥ ||
cittāyattaṃ nṝṇāṃ śukraṃ śukrāyattaṃ ca jīvitam |
tasmāc chukraṃ manaś caiva rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnataḥ ||
ṛtumatyā rajo.py evaṃ nijaṃ binduṃ ca rakṣayet |
sahajolir iyaṃ proktā śraddheyā yogibhiḥ sadā |
nirmatsarāṇāṃ vai sidhyen na tu matsaraśālinām ||
amarīṃ yaḥ piben nityaṃ nasyaṃ kurvan dine dine |
abhyāsān niḥsṛtāṃ cāndrīṃ vibhūtyā saha miśrayet |
yadi nārī rajo rakṣed vajrolyā sāpi yoginī ||
tasyāḥ kiṃcid rajo nāśaṃ na gacchati na saṃśayaḥ |
tasyāḥ śarīre nādaś ca bindutām eva gacchati ||
sa bindus tad rajaś caiva ekībhūya svadehagau |
rakṣed ākuñcanād ūrdhvaṃ yā rajaḥ sā hi yoginī |
atītānāgataṃ vetti khecarī ca bhaved dhruvam ||
ayaṃ puṇyakaro yogo bhoge bhukte.pi muktidaḥ ||
udghāṭayet kapāṭaṃ tu yathā kuñcikayā haṭhāt |
kandordhve kuṇḍalī śaktiḥ suptā mokṣāya yoginām |
bandhanāya ca mūḍhānāṃ yas tāṃ vetti sa yogavit ||
sā śaktiś cālitā yena sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
balātkāreṇa gṛhṇīyāt tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
iḍā bhagavatī gaṅgā piṅgalā yamunā nadī |
pucche pragṛhya bhujaṃgīṃ suptām udbodhayec ca tām |
nidrāṃ vihāya sā śaktir ūrdhvam uttiṣṭhate haṭhāt ||
avasthitā caiva phaṇāvatī sā prātaś ca sāyaṃ praharārdhamātram |
prapūrya sūryāt paridhānayuktyā pragṛhya nityaṃ paricālanīyā ||
sati vajrāsane pādau karābhyāṃ dhārayed dṛḍham |
vajrāsane sthito yogī cālayitvā ca kuṇḍalīm |
kuryād anantaraṃ bhastrāṃ kuṇḍalīm āśu bodhayet ||
bhānor ākuñcanaṃ kuryāt kuṇḍalīṃ cālayet tataḥ |
tena kuṇḍalinī tasyāḥ suṣumṇāyā mukhaṃ dhruvam |
jahāti tasmāt prāṇo.yaṃ suṣumṇāṃ vrajati svataḥ ||
yena saṃcālitā śaktiḥ sa yogī siddhibhājanam |
kim atra bahunoktena kālaṃ jayati līlayā ||
kuṇḍalīṃ cālayitvā tu bhastrāṃ kuryād viśeṣataḥ |
evam abhyasyato nityaṃ yamino yamabhīḥ kutaḥ ||
iyaṃ tu madhyamā nāḍī dṛḍhābhyāsena yoginām |
abhyāse tu vinidrāṇāṃ mano dhṛtvā samādhinā |
rudrāṇī vā parā mudrā bhadrāṃ siddhiṃ prayacchati ||
rājayogaṃ vinā pṛthvī rājayogaṃ vinā niśā |
column5: haṭhaṃ vinā rājayogo rājayogaṃ vinā haṭhaḥ |

column3: rājayogaṃ vinā mudrā vicitrāpi na śobhate ||
iti mudrā daśa proktā ādināthena śambhunā |
upadeśaṃ hi mudrāṇāṃ yo datte sāmpradāyikam |
sa eva śrīguruḥ svāmī sākṣād īśvara eva saḥ ||
rājayogaḥ samādhiś ca unmanī ca manonmanī |
amaratvaṃ layas tattvaṃ śūnyāśūnyaṃ paraṃ padam ||
jīvanmuktiś ca sahajā turyā cety ekavācakāḥ ||
salile saindhavaṃ yadvat sāmyaṃ bhajati yogataḥ |
yadā saṃkṣīyate prāṇo mānasaṃ ca pralīyate |
rājayogasya māhātmyaṃ ko vā jānāti tattvataḥ |
jñānaṃ muktiḥ sthitiḥ siddhir guruvākyena labhyate ||
vividhair āsanaiḥ kumbhair vicitraiḥ karaṇair api |
amarāya namas tubhyaṃ so .pi kālas tvayā jitaḥ |
patitaṃ vadane yasya jagad etac carācaram ||
citte samatvam āpanne vāyau vrajati madhyame |
jñānaṃ kuto manasi sambhavatīha tāvat prāṇo.pi jīvati mano mriyate na yāvat |
prāṇo mano dvayam idaṃ vilayaṃ nayed yo mokṣaṃ sa gacchati naro na kathaṃcid anyaḥ ||
jñātvā suṣumṇāsadbhedaṃ kṛtvā vāyuṃ ca madhyagam |
bhoktrī suṣumnā kālasya guhyam etad udāhṛtam ||
suṣumṇā śāmbhavī śaktiḥ śeṣās tv eva nirarthakāḥ ||
vāyuḥ paricito yasmād agninā saha kuṇḍalīm |
pavano badhyate yena manas tenaiva badhyate |
manaś ca badhyate yena pavanas tena badhyate ||
hetudvayaṃ tu cittasya vāsanā ca samīraṇaḥ |
tayor vinaṣṭa ekasmin tau dvāv api vinaśyataḥ ||
mano yatra vilīyeta pavanas tatra līyate |
column5: pavano līyate yatra manas tatra vilīyate ||

column3: dugdhāmbuvat saṃmilitāv ubhau tau tulyakriyau mānasamārutau hi |
yato marut tatra manaḥpravṛttir yato manas tatra marutpravṛttiḥ ||
raso baddho mano baddhaṃ kiṃ na sidhyati bhūtale ||
mūrchito harate vyādhīn mṛto jīvayati svayam |
column5: mūrchito harati vyādhiṃ mṛto jīvayati svayam |

column3: baddhaḥ khecaratāṃ dhatte raso vāyuś ca pārvati ||
manaḥ sthairyaṃ sthiro vāyus tato binduḥ sthiro bhavet |
indriyāṇāṃ mano nātho manonāthas tu mārutaḥ |
mārutasya layo nāthaḥ sa layo nādam āśritaḥ ||
so .yam evāstu mokṣākhyo māstu vāpi matāntare |
niśceṣṭo nirvikāraś ca layo jayati yoginām ||
sā śaktir jīvabhūtānāṃ dve alakṣye layaṃ gate ||
layo laya iti prāhuḥ kīdṛśaṃ layalakṣaṇam |
ekaiva śāmbhavī mudrā guptā kulavadhūr iva ||
eṣā sā śāmbhavī mudrā vedaśāstreṣu gopitā ||
antar lakṣyavilīnacittapavano yogī yadā vartate dṛṣṭyā niścalatārayā bahir adhaḥ paśyann apaśyann api |
mudreyaṃ khalu śāmbhavī bhavati sā labdhā prasādād guroḥ śūnyāśūnyavilakṣaṇaṃ sphurati tat tattvaṃ padaṃ śāmbhavam ||
tāre jyotiṣi saṃyojya kiṃcid unnamayed bhruvau |
kecit tarkeṇa muhyanti naiva jānanti tārakam ||
ardhonmīlitalocanaḥ sthiramanā nāsāgradattekṣaṇaś candrārkāv api līnatām upanayan niṣpandabhāvena yaḥ |
jyotīrūpam aśeṣabījam akhilaṃ dedīpyamānaṃ paraṃ tattvaṃ tatpadam eti vastu paramaṃ vācyaṃ kim atrādhikam ||
divā na pūjayel liṅgaṃ rātrau caiva na pūjayet |
tiṣṭhate khecarī mudrā tasmin sthāne na saṃśayaḥ ||
tiṣṭhate khecarī mudrā tatra satyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
saṃsthitā vyomacakre yā sā mudrā nāma khecarī ||
somād yatroditā dhārā sākṣāt sā śivavallabhā |
pūrayed atulāṃ divyāṃ suṣumṇāṃ paścime mukhe ||
purastāc caiva pūryeta niścitā khecarī bhavet |
bhruvor madhye śivasthānaṃ manas tatra vilīyate |
jñātavyaṃ tatpadaṃ turyaṃ tatra kālo na vidyate ||
abhyaset khecarīṃ tāvad yāvat syād yoganidritaḥ |
nirālambaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcid api cintayet |
column5: ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayet ||

column3: bāhyavāyur yathā līnas tathā madhyo na saṃśayaḥ |
svasthāne sthiratām eti pavano manasā saha ||
abhyāsāj jīryate vāyur manas tatraiva līyate ||
manasā mana ālokya dhārayet paramaṃ padam ||
khamadhye kuru cātmānam ātmamadhye ca khaṃ kuru |
sarvaṃ ca khamayaṃ kṛtvā na kiṃcid api cintayet ||
antaḥ śūnyo bahiḥ śūnyaḥ śūnyaḥ kumbha ivāmbare |
antaḥ pūrṇo bahiḥ pūrṇaḥ pūrṇaḥ kumbha ivārṇave ||
sarvacintāṃ parityajya na kiṃcid api cintayet ||
saṃkalpamātramatim utsṛja nirvikalpam āśritya niścayam avāpnuhi rāma śāntim ||
karpūram anale yadvat saindhavaṃ salile yathā |
tathā saṃdhīyamānaṃ ca manas tattve vilīyate ||
jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ pratītaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca mana ucyate |
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ samaṃ naṣṭaṃ nānyaḥ panthā dvitīyakaḥ ||
manodṛśyam idaṃ sarvaṃ yat kiṃcit sacarācaram |
nādānusaṃdhānakam ekam eva manyāmahe mukhyatamaṃ layānām ||
muktāsane sthito yogī mudrāṃ saṃdhāya śāmbhavīm |
śṛṇuyād dakṣiṇe karṇe nādam antastham ekadhīḥ ||
ārambhaś ca ghaṭaś caiva tathā paricayo.pi ca |
brahmagranther bhaved bhedo hy ānandaḥ śūnyasambhavaḥ |
dṛḍhāsano bhaved yogī jñānī devasamas tadā ||
atiśūnye vimardaś ca bherīśabdas tadā bhavet ||
astu vā māstu vā muktir atraivākhaṇḍitaṃ sukham |
ānandam ekaṃ vacasām agamyaṃ jānāti taṃ śrīgurunātha ekaḥ ||
karṇau pidhāya hastābhyāṃ yaḥ śṛṇoti dhvaniṃ muniḥ |
tatra cittaṃ sthirīkuryād yāvat sthirapadaṃ vrajet ||
pakṣād vikṣepam akhilaṃ jitvā yogī sukhī bhavet ||
tatra sūkṣmāt sūkṣmataraṃ nādam eva parāmṛśet ||
ghanam utsṛjya vā sūkṣme sūkṣmam utsṛjya vā ghane |
ramamāṇam api kṣiptaṃ mano nānyatra cālayet ||
yatra kutrāpi vā nāde lagati prathamaṃ manaḥ |
makarandaṃ piban bhṛṅgī gandhaṃ nāpekṣate yathā |
nādāsaktaṃ tathā cittaṃ viṣayān nahi kāṅkṣate ||
prayāti sutarāṃ sthairyaṃ chinnapakṣaḥ khago yathā ||
vismṛtya sarvam ekāgraḥ kutracin nahi dhāvati ||
kāṣṭhe pravartito vahniḥ kāṣṭhena saha śāmyati |
nāde pravartitaṃ cittaṃ nādena saha līyate ||
praharaṇam api sukaraṃ syāc charasaṃdhānapravīṇaś cet ||
manas tatra layaṃ yāti tad viṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam ||
yat kiṃcin nādarūpeṇa śrūyate śaktir eva sā |
yas tattvānto nirākāraḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||
tattvaṃ bījaṃ haṭhaḥ kṣetram audāsīnyaṃ jalaṃ tribhiḥ |
mṛtavat tiṣṭhate yogī sa mukto nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
khādyate na ca kālena bādhyate na ca karmaṇā |
sādhyate na sa kenāpi yogī yuktaḥ samādhinā ||
na gandhaṃ na rasaṃ rūpaṃ na ca sparśaṃ na niḥsvanam |
column5: śabde sparśe ca rūpe ca gandheṣu ca raseṣu ca |

column3: nātmānaṃ na paraṃ vetti yogī yuktaḥ samādhinā ||
cittaṃ na suptaṃ no jāgrat smṛtivismṛtivarjitam |
na cāstam eti nodeti yasyāsau mukta eva saḥ ||
na vijānāti śītoṣṇaṃ na duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ tathā |
na mānaṃ nopamānaṃ ca yogī yuktaḥ samādhinā ||
niḥśvāsocchvāsahīnaś ca niścitaṃ mukta eva saḥ ||
yāvan naiva praviśati caran māruto madhyamārge yāvad vidur na bhavati dṛḍhaḥ prāṇavātaprabandhāt |
yāvad dhyāne sahajasadṛśaṃ jāyate naiva tattvaṃ tāvaj jñānaṃ vadati tad idaṃ dambhamithyāpralāpaḥ ||
